1084-3845-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-3845-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-3845-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1003-1927-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-1927-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1824-3497-4549.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-3497-4549.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
1824-3497-4549.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

5660-6294-6872.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {0}.
Marketback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6753-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

630-2366-5295-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-2366-5295-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

5638-7070--141.easyPrerequisites: You are able to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more.
5638-7070--141.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
5638-7070--141.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the affinity creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to its affinity ability.
Repeat.
5638-7070--141.notes: You want to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more using its affinity ability. For example, if you choose Ancestral Statue, you need to control two or more attacking creatures.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2173-2292-4740-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2292-4740-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

2457-3000-4289-4927.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1069-2796.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-2796.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Equipment's ability, attaching it to Cephalid Aristrocrat.
Repeat.

678-4476-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-4476-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1110-1339-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1110-1339-6092.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4030-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

549-703-1270-2637-4659.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six token copies of Mechtitan Core that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two of the Mechtitan Core tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate a Mechtitan Core by paying {5} and exiling it, three other Mechtitan Core tokens, and Astral Dragon, creating three 10/10 Mechtitan legendary creature tokens.
Put all but one of the Mechtitan tokens in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mechtitan Core triggers twice, returning all cards exiled to create the Mechtitan tokens from exile to the battlefield.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mechtitan, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating six token copies of Mechtitan Core that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego sacrificing Mechtitan Core tokens to Krark-Clan Ironworks, and then target any other applicable permanents using Astral Dragon.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

313-1170-1749-2557-4113.notablePrerequisites:
Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
You control at least two additional creatures.
313-1170-1749-2557-4113.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by tapping Caetus, Vampire Hexmage and three other creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Caetus and causing it to return to the battlefield as Invasion of Segovia.
When Invasion of Segovia enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Kraken creature tokens.
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Segovia.
Invasion of Segovia triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Vampire Hexmage from your graveyard to the battlefield and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.

2073-2364-3698-4241.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Mana Vault to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mana Vault.
When Mana Vault dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mana Vault enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

507-4469.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell from their hand, Possibility Storm triggers, exiling the spell and allowing the player to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a spell that shares a type with the exiled spell, and cast it without paying its mana cost.
If the opponent chooses to cast the spell, Lavinia triggers, countering that spell since no mana was spent to cast it.

1000-2087-2104-2493.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
1000-2087-2104-2493.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast Spore Swarm by paying {3}{G}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Temporal Manipulation, and Spore Swarm to your hand.
Repeat.
